disposition.reason: A neighbor appeals the Middlebury DRB's decision upholding the Zoning Administrator's refusal to take enforcement action (screening, grading, future student rentals) at an existing residence. It is a municipal appeal, but no new housing is proposed or permitted.

evidence.quote: John McPartland (Appellant) appeals a June 5, 2024 decision by the Middlebury Development Review Board (DRB) denying his appeal
determination by the Zoning Administrator (Zoning Administrator) declining to take enforcement action against Richard Tinsley for alleged zoning violations
enforcement actions that would require Mr. Tinsley to screen a dumpster and parking area on the Property, to submit a zoning plan for grading and stormwater management
it is undisputed that such student housing is not presently occurring at the Property, nor it is presently proposed for future use/approval.

judgments.note: Appeal of a DRB decision upholding a zoning administrator's refusal to enforce against an existing residence; subjects are screening, grading/drainage and possible future student rentals (change of occupancy), none of which is new housing. Excluded.
Appeal to the Environmental Division of a Middlebury DRB decision on a zoning administrator determination.
No construction or new unit is proposed; the only housing aspect is past/possible future rental to students, a change of occupancy without construction, which the guide classes as not new housing.

history.note: Excluded: enforcement-refusal appeal about screening and grading at an existing house; no new housing.
